title: SELECT specific columns
description: Write a query that returns the `first_name` and `last_name` of every row in the `customers` table.
hints: SELECT column1, column2 FROM table lists exactly the columns you want, in the order you name them - unlike SELECT *, which returns every column.
Select first_name and last_name from customers - no WHERE or ORDER BY needed for this one.
expected_behavior: Returns first_name and last_name for every customer, in table order.
explanation: SELECT is the clause that names which columns come back - listing exactly the ones you want is more explicit (and usually faster) than SELECT * when you only need a few.
